blockingFindings.title: POSIX liveness ignores post-capture group members
blockingFindings.issue: After timeout, `_captureOriginalPosixMembers()` snapshots the process group before SIGTERM, and subsequent liveness checks in `processGroupHasNoLiveOriginalMembers()` only inspect those original identities. Any process that joins or is forked into the same process group after that snapshot is ignored, so the supervisor can settle while a live same-group descendant remains.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In `processGroupHasNoLiveOriginalMembers()`, combine identity filtering for originally captured PIDs with a fresh process-group scan that treats non-zombie members with uncaptured PIDs as live, while still excluding PID-reused originals by start fingerprint.
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 is mapped to POSIX finite timeout settlement for the process tree. Settling while a live process-group member remains contradicts the mandatory process-tree termination behavior and can leave unterminated subprocesses behind.

blockingFindings.title: Unterminated diagnostics omit live uncaptured members
blockingFindings.issue: `_collectUnterminatedPosixMembers()` reads only `originalPosixMembers`, then filters by matching original identity. Live non-zombie members that were forked after `_captureOriginalPosixMembers()` are not included in `AgentTimeoutError.unterminatedMembers`.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Update `_collectUnterminatedPosixMembers()` to report every current non-zombie member in the process group, excluding only PIDs that are known PID-reuse mismatches for captured identities.
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 requires the final deadline to report each unfinished non-zombie member. The current implementation can produce incomplete diagnostics for still-running process-tree members, so this is tied to a mandatory acceptance requirement.
